name: Immediate Delete Clone after Broadcast
hint: The script deletes the clone immediately after the [sbi]broadcast ( v)[/sbi] block. The script that starts with [sbi]when I receive [ v][/sbi] for this message in this clone of the Sprite won't be executed right.
instruction: It is better to use a [sbi]broadcast ( v) and wait[/sbi] block instead.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when i start as a clone
forever
if <touching (#000) ?> then
change [points v] by (1)
broadcast (boom v) :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
delete this clone
end
end

when i receive (boom v)
play sound (explosion v) until done

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when i start as a clone
forever
if <touching (#000) ?> then
change [points v] by (1)
broadcast (boom v) and wait :: #007000 //⇦  👍
delete this clone
end
end

when i receive (boom v)
play sound (explosion v) until done
